name: Algorithms Visual Handbook
subject: algorithms
tagline: An algorithm is a system of parts. Watch the items move.
blurb: A stack is a box with things in it; a queue is a belt with a policy; a sort is a load changing places. Every model here runs, and the answer comes out of parts moving — never out of a script.
